name: Production Milestone & Repository Hygiene
changes: Promotes the proven v3.6.99 application to the v3.7 production milestone without changing user-facing runtime behavior outside version identity.
Removes the obsolete duplicate windows-release.yml workflow so the guarded publish-release-trigger.yml pipeline is the single authoritative Windows production release path.
Modernizes release/windows/README.md and src/README.md to describe the current source/build topology without stale v3.5.33 guidance or missing documentation links.
Makes THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md version-neutral so current third-party licensing statements do not become stale on every NewzDeck version bump.
regression_guards: v3.6.99 Backup & Restore, v3.6.96 A/An/The library sorting, all twelve themes, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, and the Defender-clean native/update architecture remain unchanged.
The obsolete manual windows-release.yml workflow is absent and the canonical publish-release-trigger.yml workflow runs the complete historical regression chain plus the v3.7.0 hygiene guard.
Repository source/build documentation contains no stale v3.5.33 current-tree wording, no missing RELEASE_COMPLIANCE.md reference, and no v3.6.93-specific third-party statements.
styles.css, themes.css, Picker, Launcher, yEnc helper source, installer, and Portable builder remain on their proven v3.6.99 baselines.
preserved: v3.6.99 portable Settings and Automation Backup & Restore.
v3.6.96 Automation library A/An/The-aware presentation sorting.
v3.6.95 theme readability and all twelve palettes.
Newsgroup Browser, Downloads, Smart Import, Automation search/grab/import behavior, private SABnzbd 5.1.2, updater ownership, Picker/yEnc and installer behavior.
